review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 instruments/displays machine spec and canonical style bible; SHA-256, byte count and dimensions verified locally; untouched source archived to the E2 rejected Drive folder.
rejection_reasons: Reference class failure: most requested specimens were substituted with analog gauges or active display instruments.
Forbidden active screen content, numerical display content and previous-era analog instrumentation appeared.
Only the atomic 4x2 layout and general pixel-art style passed; the sheet cannot be canonical evidence.
